page_title: MAL 1-2 CEL | Mallorca v Celta Vigo 05/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Ricardo De Burgos is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) replaces Oscar Mingueza.

90+2' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Dominik Greif easily makes the save.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' The attendance for today's match is 18291.
89' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

89' That's unlucky! Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

87' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
85' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the left side of the goal, but Dominik Greif was alert and made an amazing save!
82' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
81' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
79' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) replaces Pablo Duran.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alfonso Gonzalez leaves the pitch and Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) comes on.

76' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
76' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
76' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Mallorca earn a corner.
74' Daniel Rodriguez will be replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
72' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Oscar Mingueza plays it into the box, and Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of the cross to put it inside the left post. 1:2.
71' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
67' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
65' Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul after Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) for Iago Aspas.
63' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.

61' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
61' Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Takuma Asano is replaced by Valery (Mallorca).
59' Here comes a substitution. Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Manu Morlanes.
58' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
58' The ball possession is 41:59.
53' Today's referee Ricardo De Burgos rightly decides to book Jose Copete (Mallorca) for his harsh tackle.

53' 1 - 1 Goal! Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Dominik Greif had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:1.
53' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) was too forceful with his tackle and Ricardo De Burgos interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
52' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo De Burgos has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
51' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Vicente Guaita is equal to it and makes an easy save.
50' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
47' A cross from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+4' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Ricardo De Burgos ignores the protests.
45+3' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
45+1' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:1.
43' Rough tackle by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Ricardo De Burgos didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
40' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) forces a pass into the box, but Dominik Greif is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
38' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
37' Jagoba Arrasate is forced to make a change. Vedat Muriqi is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Cyle Larin (Mallorca).
36' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) picks up an injury.
32' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
31' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo).
29' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul.
27' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
23' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
21' The possession of the ball – 46:54.

17' 1 - 0 Goal! Martin Valjent (Mallorca) peels away from his marker to meet the resulting free kick from Sergi Darder, and he steers a powerful header from near the penalty spot inside the left post. What a finish that is - 1:0!
16' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Celta Vigo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
11' Flag goes up against Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
7' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) makes contact with a cross but fails to connect perfectly. The ball heads right towards the middle of the goal where the goalkeeper makes a decent save to deny him.
6' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
4' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) makes a slide tackle, but referee Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul.
3' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but Vicente Guaita comes off his line to gather the ball.
3' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Ricardo De Burgos will officiate today.
